profile: Utilities and industrial engineer, water-heavy. Books everything it drives as a conduit contract, which is how the only soft-ground drive under a live station in this consortium is filed as industrial work.

projects.title: Light Rail Utility Relocation Programme
projects.narrative: Relocation of water, gas and telecoms utilities ahead of a light rail extension, phased across eleven street crossings.

projects.title: Transit Corridor Drainage Renewal
projects.narrative: Drainage and culvert renewal along an operating rail corridor, delivered in night possessions.

projects.title: Airport Fuel and Hydrant System
projects.narrative: Aviation fuel farm and airside hydrant distribution with automated leak detection.

projects.title: North Relief Conduit
projects.narrative: A 3.2 km relief conduit driven through soft ground beneath a tidal channel, with intermediate shafts and a compressed air working chamber.

projects.title: Regional Water Treatment Expansion
projects.narrative: Membrane treatment expansion and a high-lift pumping hall at a regional water plant.

projects.title: Effluent Pretreatment Plant
projects.narrative: Effluent pretreatment plant and equalisation basins serving a data campus cooling loop.

projects.title: Coastal Outfall Replacement
projects.narrative: Marine outfall replacement with a bored diffuser section and a temporary cofferdam at the shoreline.

projects.title: State Reservoir Spillway Reconstruction
projects.narrative: Spillway and stilling basin reconstruction at a state reservoir, executed between flood seasons.

projects.title: Downtown District Cooling Network
projects.narrative: District cooling network with a central plant and four energy transfer substations across a downtown grid.

projects.title: Restricted Process Water Facility
projects.narrative: Process water facility delivered under a facility clearance; the client, the location and the process are not disclosable.

people.name: Yara Mansour
people.bio: Tunnelling lead on the north relief conduit: a soft-ground bore advanced under compressed air beneath live platforms and an operating station box, with a settlement-control regime agreed with the operator.

people.name: Grace Adeyinka

people.bio: Geotechnical lead for dams, spillways and deep excavation support.

people.bio: Mechanical lead for water treatment and district cooling plant.
